# TRUST_BUNDLE

A CA bundle distributed into namespaces, for workloads that verify the lab's own certificates.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `trust`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.trust`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

## Fields

| field | type |
| --- | --- |
| caBundle | record { key, name } |
| caBundleSecret | null or record { key, name } |
| namespace | kubernetes name (DNS-1123 label) |
| secretTargets | bool |
